members.name: Philip Adrian Booth (twin brother of Christopher St. Booth)

podcast.title: 1976 Major Hit and Juno Award
podcast.body: Sweeny Todd achieved a major hit in 1976, which earned them a Juno award, a significant recognition in the Canadian music industry. "They had a major hit in 1976, which won them a general award."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Band Breakup
podcast.body: The band Sweeny Todd disbanded in 1978, leading its members, including Christopher St. Booth and his twin brother Philip Adrian Booth, to pursue other ventures. "Swini Todd broke up in 1978."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Composing for Porn Films
xref.body: Christopher St. Booth, after his band Sweeny Todd broke up, moved to Encino, California, and took on odd jobs. When offered an opportunity by a friend who made porn films, he started writing music for them due to the good money, carefully registering the copyrights with Sokan, the Canadian Performing Arts Organization. "Then, a friend who made porn said, I need music for one of my new films. Can you do it? Sure they can."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
